bus_stop_rate — DRIVE traffic op

• 資料種類:any → any

• 呼叫: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.bus_stop_rate(x, *, bus_rear: 'float', bus_front: 'float', base: 'float', peak: 'float', spread: 'float')(要直接呼叫實作,import drivetraffic; drivetraffic.bus_stop_rate(x, *, bus_rear: 'float', bus_front: 'float', base: 'float', peak: 'float', spread: 'float');從台帳取用則 opsdrive.get("bus_stop_rate"))

用法

在停靠公車前後較高的出現率 λ(x) = base + peak [exp(−½((x − rear)/spread)²) + exp(−½((x − front)/spread)²)] [次/m]。表示行人從公車的陰影(前端之前)與後方走出的模式範例(值為呼叫端的假定)。上限為 base + 2·peak。
